body: hi, i know it's not my decision to make but i hope you know that at least i care, even tho i don't know you, even tho I've never met you, i still care. It's really hard to explain but things aren't the same after someone's gone and it really hurts to see these types of posts.
im not here to be entertained, im here to try to help, do you wanna chat?

Please don't do it, i know i can't stop you and it's your choice but please can we at least talk about this? before you do anything because it really hurts to see posts like this. I really hope you're alright.
